name: io.github.zerotaldev/ozow
title: Ozow
description: Create and track Ozow instant EFT payments in South Africa. Staging-locked by default.

environmentVariables.name: OZOW_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: One API client ID from the Ozow Portal

environmentVariables.name: OZOW_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: One API client secret from the Ozow Portal

environmentVariables.name: OZOW_SITE_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Ozow site code in the form XXX-XXX-XXX

environmentVariables.name: OZOW_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Which Ozow environment to use. Staging moves no real money.

environmentVariables.name: OZOW_ALLOW_PRODUCTION
environmentVariables.description: Must be set to 'i-understand-this-moves-real-money' when OZOW_ENV is production. Without it the server refuses to start.

environmentVariables.name: OZOW_MAX_AMOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling in rands on any single payment request
